title: Clarifying Organization Security Requirements for a team

question.author: member_297
question.body: Before I explain organization security requirements to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: Admins can audit devices and sessions from the admin console and remotely sign out a lost laptop. All organization accounts must enroll in two-factor authentication; this requirement took effect with CloudBox 2.1 and applies to every member, including guests. Organizations on Business and Enterprise plans can additionally enable SSO (SAML or OIDC), which centralizes sign-in but does not replace the 2FA requirement. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
